subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text :
stimulus: why don't you attend classes regularly the teacher said to the boy you cannot expect good results unless you attend classes as i tell you i am sorry sir said the student Part B : Composition (40 Marks)
guide_solution: "Why don't you attend classes regularly?" the teacher said to the boy. "You cannot expect good results unless you attend classes as I tell you." "I am sorry, sir," said the student.  For Question No. 12, 13, 14 & 15, See Solution to Suggestions; Composition Part ইংরেজি দ্বিতীয় পত্র  109
